title: KGB department researching unknown flying and underwater objects

tellings.quote: president showed to our leader. Back then, there was a special department of administration within the KGB of the USSR for researching these unknown flying and not just flying, but also underwater objects.

plain: In Soviet times, a special department inside the KGB, the Soviet secret police and spy service, studied unknown objects, both ones that flew and ones under water. Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a Russian republic who says aliens took him in 1997, relays this from what was shown to the country's leader, and he links it to Mikhail Gorbachev, the last Soviet leader. If true, it would mean the Soviet state had its own secret UFO study.
